name: Gerben-Jan Gerbrandy - § 80 - Am 46
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section I – European Parliament
part_text: 80. Recalls that the Treaties designate Strasbourg as Parliament’s official seat; regrets that this is not the case, resulting in considerable construction, acquisition, and maintenance costs at the various sites and cities, as well as costs for transferring equipment between the Brussels and Strasbourg offices during plenary sessions, instead of ensuring the efficient use of the Union’s budget and avoiding the waste of European taxpayers’ money;
